title: Why RTO went up
persona: Ethnic wear founder who ships most orders cash on delivery and has seen more parcels come back lately; wants to know where, not a lecture.
opening: My RTO has gone up in the last two weeks. Why?

facts.which window: the last 14 days against the 14 before
facts.what RTO means here: parcels the courier marked returned to origin

success: says the window and that the rate is counted over shipments delivered or returned, with the ones still on their way said apart
says the rise is on cash on delivery, with COD's own rate beside prepaid's, and that both couriers moved alike
says this is what was seen in the shipments, not a proven cause
ends with a next step the owner can take, such as confirming COD orders before they ship
must_not: blames one courier without numbers to show it
a rate counted over every shipment, the ones still on their way included
